description: Takes one service off the list, whatever was decided about it: the next build that needs it is checked again (a public service is allowed again by itself; one of the person's own is asked about again). Only owners and admins can remove one.

host.description: The service's web address, such as api.yourbookings.com (a pasted link works too).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: remove_build_access
title: Forget a decision about a service
